messages:
incident-bot: PAGE: Incident 4821 - elevated 5xx rate in eu-west ingestion. Current 5xx: 14% (baseline 1.5%). Auto-steer moved ~18% of traffic to economy lanes. Paging oncall-nina.
oncall-nina: taking pager. quick context pls — any customer reports?
cs-maria: getting pings from a major customer (Acct: FinCore) about timeouts.
sre-rohan: digging into metrics. It looks like upstream cache nodes in eu-west are returning 502s under load. Premium lane shows fewer errors, economy is saturated.
eng-runtime-kai: show current smart-routing policy for eu-west.
sre-rohan: paste policy snippet:
```
smart-routing: v5
- region: eu-west
  order: [premium, standard, economy]
  fallback_to_economy: true
  latency_weight: 0.6
  cost_weight: 0.4
```
oncall-nina: mitigation plan proposal (short-lived):
1) temporarily disable fallback_to_economy for eu-west (5m) to prevent thrashing
2) cap economy tier at 200rps per-pop
3) enable aggressive draining: shift new connections away from economy
4) bump premium soft-quota for FinCore to avoid rate-limits
please ack asap.
eng-runtime-kai: i can push changes. doing dry-run for caps and fallback toggle.
ops-bot: action: routing.config.dryrun requested by eng-runtime-kai. id=dr-4821.
eng-runtime-kai: dry-run ok. applying cap and toggles.
ops-bot: action: routing.update applied by eng-runtime-kai. change=chg-4821-1. details: economy_cap=200rps eu-west, fallback_to_economy=false (5m TTL).
sre-rohan: metrics: error-rate falling to 6% within 45s. tailing logs for 502 signatures.
cs-maria: FinCore confirms some improvement but still seeing bursts of 504s in a small shard.
oncall-nina: next step: isolate shard causing backend timeouts and steer affected shard to reserve pool.
eng-runtime-kai: initiating shard steer: `redwoodctl steer --region eu-west --shard eu-west-3 --target reserved --reason "inc 4821 emergency steer"`
ops-bot: action: steer initiated by eng-runtime-kai. change=chg-4821-2.
ops-bot: success: shard eu-west-3 steered to reserved pool.
sre-rohan: post-steer: 5xx for that shard dropped to 0.8%, overall eu-west 5xx now 1.9%.
oncall-nina: great. keep fallback disabled until stable + 4m. also apply quota bump for FinCore: +30% for 20m.
eng-runtime-kai: applying quota bump: `redwoodctl quota adjust --account FinCore --tier premium --delta +30% --ttl 20m`.
ops-bot: success: quota chg-4821-3 applied.
product-oliver: any user-visible side effects? cost blowup risk? we should notify billing leads.
cs-maria: FinCore says latency improved and errors dropped. I'll send a status note.
oncall-nina: rolling summary for postmortem: cause = upstream cache node timeouts in eu-west-3 causing cascading fallback to economy which saturated cheaper paths; mitigations = disable fallback_to_economy, cap economy tier, steer bad shard to reserved pool, temporary quota bump for affected customer. owners: eng-runtime-kai (routing changes), sre-rohan (metrics/analysis), cs-maria (customer comms), product-oliver (policy follow-up).
sre-rohan: recommendation: add a circuit-breaker rule so that when a shard's error rate > 5% we stop falling back to economy for that shard automatically, and increase latency_weight in high-error windows.
product-oliver: filing RFC for adaptive cost/latency weighting and shard-level fallback controls.
oncall-nina: status -> MITIGATED. maintaining monitoring and will hand off to follow-up oncall at 04:12 UTC.
incident-bot: Incident 4821 - MITIGATED by oncall-nina. peak 5xx 14% -> 1.9% baseline. Jira: INF-4821.
eng-runtime-kai: saved routing diffs to /runbooks/incidents/INF-4821/diffs.txt and captured commands in runbook.
oncall-nina: post-incident tasks: 1) triage RFC 2) run synthetic regression on eu-west shards 3) cost report for reserved pool usage increase.
cs-maria: customer comms draft in ticket INF-4821-COMM ready for review.
oncall-nina: thanks team. closing pager now. good coordination. :thumbsup:
